task: Make decision-doc three-round two-host verification a hard DONE gate.
outcome: User runs `lattice story_advance {"storyId":"B-xxxx","phase":"DONE"}` after changing `docs/requirements/decisions/*.md`; without fresh 3x2 host verdicts they see `Cannot enter DONE: decision-doc quorum missing ...`, and with three fresh two-host PASS rounds DONE proceeds normally.
facts: B-4e06 recorded decision-doc host_verdict process events but the lifecycle did not mechanically require them.
Existing autopilot_review_submit writes type=host_verdict events into process-events.jsonl with runId, hostId, provider, decision, and materialDigest.
DONE transition is guarded by canFinishGuard/getGuardFailureReason in packages/main/src/core/machine.ts.
Core decision docs live under docs/requirements/decisions/*.md.
No existing helper computes a digest over only changed decision docs, so this story will add a small dedicated digest helper rather than reuse full-tree currentMaterialHash.
AGENTS.md requires new or modified gate-consumed workflow facts to update both packages/main/src/core/process-fact-registry.ts and scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs.
constraints: Do not auto-spawn hosts; the gate only consumes already-recorded host_verdict facts.
Do not require Authority receipt server integration for this local quorum gate.
Do not weaken existing test, bug, delivery-check, review-pass, or scope gates.
Do not touch OMX or .omx paths.
